column1: # Per-file changed-line budget for the costly delta against upstream:
#   - every modified upstream file (git status M)
#   - every whole file outside overlay/ (git status A), including
# changed-lines = added + deleted from: git diff --numstat <base>...HEAD
# Sorted by path. TOTAL is the sum of the file budgets.
# The budget only ratchets down. overlay-diff.sh --update-budget rewrites
# this file from the current tree but refuses to raise any number unless
# you pass --allow-growth "<reason>", which appends a dated comment.
